lines.en: label tsukasaspecial1:
scene hall_day
Another week as the world’s most sexually active teacher means another week to completely ruin the lives of everyone around me by simply showing up to class.
lines.zh: : 又是一周——作为全世界性生活最活跃的老师,又有一周的机会,仅仅因为我出现在教室里,就毁掉我周围所有人的人生。

lines.en: Oh. Sorry for the self-loathing so early in the morning. I just figured that if I got it all out of the way now, I’d be able to do whatever I want for the rest of the day without thinking at all.
lines.zh: : 哦。抱歉一大早就开始自我厌恶。我只是想着,如果现在把这些全吐干净,今天剩下的时间我就可以什么都不想、想干嘛干嘛。

lines.en: Which, to be fair, is what I try to do most days to begin with.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话,大多数日子我本来就是这么干的。

lines.en: However, I was notified of a very particular “holiday” through a phone call from my assistant this morning that has put me in a particularly passive aggressive mood.
lines.zh: : 然而,今天早上,助理的一通电话通知了我一个非常特别的「节日」,让我陷入了一种格外阴阳怪气的心情。

lines.en: Especially since it requires my full presence in the classroom at the risk of both Imani and me losing our jobs. And Imani has been kind enough to me so far that I don’t want to do that to her.
lines.zh: : 尤其是这个节日要求我全程出现在教室里,否则我和 Imani 都要丢工作。而 Imani 到目前为止对我足够友善,我不想那样对她。

lines.en: Also, I’m pretty sure she’s barely hanging on by a thread financially and she kind of needs this.
lines.zh: : 而且,我相当确定她的财务已经命悬一线,她挺需要这份工作的。

lines.en: scene black
I slide open the door and prepare myself for the start of what I imagine will be the worst holiday ever- and that is saying a lot since things like Christmas exist.
lines.zh: : 我拉开教室门,做好准备迎接我预想中最糟糕的节日的开始——鉴于圣诞节的存在,这话分量不轻。

lines.en: scene tsukasaday1
But at least on Christmas you can come up with excuses to not pay attention to certain people.
lines.zh: : 但至少在圣诞节,你还能找借口躲开某些人。

lines.en: : Good morning! Happy National Tsukasa Day!
lines.zh: : 大家早安!全国月司日快乐!

lines.en: : Tsukasa, how much did you pester our poor father to make this childish dream of yours a reality?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,你到底纠缠了我们可怜的父亲多久,才让你这个幼稚的梦想成真?

lines.en: : It’s not a childish dream if I’m an ancient and powerful wizard. Just because there’s not National Touka Day doesn’t mean you can get mad at my holiday.
lines.zh: : 只要我是古老而强大的巫师,这就不是幼稚的梦想。没有「全国藤香日」不代表你可以冲我的节日发火。

lines.en: : Sensei is a very busy-
lines.zh: : Sensei 平时很忙——

lines.en: scene tsukasaday2
: Well...actually, that’s not true at all. Sensei is practically never busy.
lines.zh: : 嗯……其实,这话完全不属实。Sensei 几乎从来不忙。

lines.en: : But he’s assuredly not going to start being busy when he’s preoccupied with silly games like this.
lines.zh: : 但他肯定不会在沉迷这种愚蠢游戏的时候,突然变得忙碌。

lines.en: : Wrong again, dear sister. I’ve heard the games this adult plays and they are a lot louder than whatever is going on in this sorry excuse for a classroom.
lines.zh: : 又错了,亲爱的姐姐。我听说过这位成年人玩的游戏,它们可比这间寒酸的、冒牌教室里发生的事情响亮多了。

lines.en: : Why are you here?
lines.zh: : 你来这里干什么?

lines.en: : Because it’s National Tsukasa Day and I get to do whatever I want.
lines.zh: : 因为今天是全国月司日,我可以为所欲为。

lines.en: : So you chose to...come to high school?
lines.zh: : 所以你选择了……来上高中?

lines.en: scene tsukasaday3
: Yup!
lines.zh: : 没错!

lines.en: : The train wasn’t very exciting, so I wanted to get a closer look at the true commoner mecca! A public school!
lines.zh: : 电车实在无聊,所以我想近距离瞻仰一下真正的平民圣地!一所公立学校!

lines.en: : I even had my personal tailor make an exact copy of my sister’s uniform so I can experience firsthand the pain she endures every day as she is turned into one of you!
lines.zh: : 我甚至让我的私人裁缝,精确复刻了我姐姐的制服——好让我亲身体验她每天被同化成你们其中一员时所忍受的痛苦!

lines.en: : Sensei, how long is Tsukasa staying here?
lines.zh: : Sensei,Tsukasa 要在这里待多久?

lines.en: : While I, too, would like to know the answer to that question, I’m more concerned about what sorts of games Tsukasa has heard you playing.
lines.zh: : 虽然我也想知道答案,但我更关心的是:Tsukasa 到底听说了你在玩什么游戏。

lines.en: : To Ami, I have no idea what she’s talking about. And to Ayane, I assume she’ll only be here until the end of Tsukasa Day.
lines.zh: : 对 Ami——我完全不知道她在说什么。对 Ayane——我猜她只待到月司日结束。

lines.en: scene tsukasaday4
: Ahem! It is National Tsukasa Day! Don’t go leaving out words that describe how important it is.
lines.zh: : 咳咳!今天是全国月司日!别忘了加上形容它有多重要的字眼。

lines.en: : Also, National Tsukasa Day doesn’t end until next Wednesday because Father said so.
lines.zh: : 而且,全国月司日要到下周三才结束,因为爸爸说的。

lines.en: scene tsukasaday5
: Damn. I wish I was rich enough to change the way time works.
lines.zh: : 操。真希望我也有钱到能改变时间的运行。

lines.en: : You don’t have to be rich, Imani! All you have to do to change the way time works is get pregnant with Sensei’s baby. Well, at least according to Maya.
lines.zh: : 你不需要有钱,Imani!想改变时间的运行,只需要怀上 Sensei 的孩子。嗯,至少 Maya 是这么说的。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : I have absolutely no clue what she is talking about.
lines.zh: : 我 absolutely 不知道她在说什么。

lines.en: scene tsukasaday6
: With all due respect, Senpai, I think I’d rather take the money.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言,学姐,我宁愿拿钱。

lines.en: : You’re handsome and all, but if the way you treat my body is anything like the way you treat my mind, I can’t imagine that would be a very enjoyable experience.
lines.zh: : 你是挺帅的,但如果你对待我身体的方式,和你对待我脑子一样,我无法想象那会是一段愉快的经历。

lines.en: : Luckily for you, I don’t intend on getting anyone preg-
lines.zh: : 幸好,我没打算让任何人怀——

lines.en: : Stop paying attention to everyone not named Tsukasa on National Tsukasa Day!
lines.zh: : 在全国月司日,不许把注意力放在任何「不叫 Tsukasa」的人身上!

lines.en: scene tsukasaday7
: Right! Uhh...yeah.
: See, the issue with that is that I’m not exactly...good with kids that aren’t in high school yet. They make me feel weird. And even if today is National Tsukasa Day, you kind of...
lines.zh: : 你看,问题在于,我对付「还没上高中」的小孩,并不太……在行。她们让我感觉怪怪的。就算今天是全国月司日,你多少……

lines.en: : Well, you don’t belong here.
lines.zh: : 嗯,你不属于这里。

lines.en: : Watch it, Imani. This girl may not look intimidating, but she holds our futures in the palms of her tiny hands.
lines.zh: : 小心点,Imani。这个女孩看起来毫无威胁,但我们的未来就攥在她那双小手里。

lines.en: scene tsukasaday8
: Are you two sure you are even teachers? Because I’m hearing a whole lot of slander and not so much teaching right now.
lines.zh: : 你们俩确定自己是老师吗?因为我听到的是一大堆诽谤,没听到多少教学。

lines.en: : And I suggest that if you two want to keep your jobs, that you...actually do them.
lines.zh: : 我建议,你们俩要是想保住工作,就……真的去干你们的活。

lines.en: : I am so sorry that this is happening today. I tried my best to prevent it, but...alas.
lines.zh: : 今天发生这种事,我非常抱歉。我尽力阻止过了,但是……唉。

lines.en: : What can we even teach with someone your age here? You won’t be able to follow along.
lines.zh: : 有你这种年纪的人在场,我们还能教什么?你根本跟不上。

lines.en: : Do you take me for a lowly peasant? I have received only the highest forms of education from the most qualified teachers in all of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 你把我当成低贱的农民了吗?我接受的是 Kumon-mi 最顶尖的老师给予的最高等的教育。

lines.en: : Your meaningless squibbles disguised as educational lectures mean nothing before the greatness that is Tsukasa AKA “Tsurumi” Tsukioka of the Tsukioka family.
lines.zh: : 你们这些伪装成教学讲座的无意义涂鸦,在月冈家的 Tsukasa——又名「Tsurumi」——的伟大面前,一文不值。

lines.en: : Squibble? What’s a squibble?
lines.zh: : Squibble?什么是 squibble?

lines.en: scene tsukasaday9
: A word I made up that means “silly and pointless!” I call it a Tsukasology. Or a...Tsukasism. There’s another one right there.
lines.zh: : 一个我发明的词,意思是「愚蠢且毫无意义!」我管它叫「月司学」。或者……「月司语」。那边还有一个。

lines.en: : Creating new words is far detached from proper education, Tsukasa...AKA Tsurumi.
lines.zh: : 创造新词和正经教育相去甚远,Tsukasa……又名 Tsurumi。

lines.en: : Then try me! Ask me anything. I’m sure my answers will be far more acceptable than whatever these so-called “squobbles” would give you.
lines.zh: : 那就考考我!随便问。我确信我的答案,会比这些所谓的「涂鸦」给你的好接受得多。

lines.en: : But...no one calls them that.
lines.zh: : 可是……没有人那样称呼它们。

lines.en: menu:
What is the world’s oldest city?
lines.zh: 世界上最古老的城市是什么?

lines.en: : What is the world’s oldest city?
lines.zh: : 世界上最古老的城市是什么?

lines.en: : Damascus, Syria!
lines.zh: : 叙利亚大马士革!

lines.en: : That's a highly contested topic as many people believe it to be Jericho. But Jericho was more like a large town than a city during its early years.
lines.zh: : 这是极具争议的话题,很多人认为是杰里科。但杰里科早期更像一个大镇,还算不上城市。

lines.en: : Mother says Damascus isn’t all it’s cracked up to be, though. She visited there on one of her travels from before Kumon-mi was isolated.
lines.zh: : 不过妈妈说,大马士革没有传闻中那么好。她在 Kumon-mi 被隔离之前的一次旅行中去过那里。

lines.en: : Did she get it right?
lines.zh: : 她答对了吗?

lines.en: : I have no clue. I just asked a question thinking she wouldn’t know the answer.
lines.zh: : 我毫无头绪。我随便问了个问题,本以为她答不上来。

lines.en: : Never fear, Senpai. I will do my duties as your loyal peon and utilize the glory of my smart phone to- holy shit, she’s right.
lines.zh: : 不用怕,学姐。我会尽我忠诚喽啰的职责,动用我智能手机的荣光——我靠,她说对了。

lines.en: : Of course she is...
lines.zh: : 她当然说得对……

lines.en: How tall is Mt. Fuji?
lines.zh: : 富士山有多高?

lines.en: : How tall is Mt. Fuji?
lines.zh: : 富士山有多高?

lines.en: : Three-thousand, seven-hundred-seventy-six meters!
lines.zh: : 三千七百七十六米!

lines.en: : I’m supposed to go there with Papa once we’re allowed to leave the city again.
lines.zh: : 等允许我们再次出城,爸爸要带我去那里。

lines.en: : He says he’s going to buy part of the mountain so I can have my own little house there.
lines.zh: : 他说他要买下山的一部分,这样我就能在那里有一栋自己的小屋。

lines.en: : Is that even legal?
lines.zh: : 那合法吗?

lines.en: : Everything is legal when you’re rich. But you wouldn’t know that since you’re not.
lines.zh: : 只要有钱,什么都是合法的。但你不了解,因为你没钱。

lines.en: : That’s Ayane Amamiya you’re speaking to, Tsukasa. She comes from the second richest family in all of the city.
lines.zh: : 你在跟月冈家的月司——又名「Tsurumi」——讲话。

lines.en: : Sorry. Can’t hear you from all the way up here in first place.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我在第一名的高处,听不见。

lines.en: Who lives at the North Pole?
lines.zh: : 谁住在北极?

lines.en: : If you’re so smart, how about you tell me who lives at the North Pole?
lines.zh: : 你不是自称聪明吗,那你告诉我,谁住在北极?

lines.en: scene tsukasaday10
: Bruh.
lines.zh: : 兄弟。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : The North Pole?
lines.zh: : 北极?

lines.en: : Do you take me for a fool, commoner?
lines.zh: : 你把我当成傻瓜了吗,平民?

lines.en: : Everyone knows that’s where Santa’s workshop is. That was barely even a question.
lines.zh: : 所有人都知道,圣诞老人的工坊在那里。这连问题都算不上。

lines.en: : Are you sure about that?
lines.zh: : 你确定?

lines.en: : Yes. Unless you mean to tell me it is my mother who has been returning my annual letters to him. And that would just be utter nonsense.
lines.zh: : 对。除非你想告诉我:每年给我回信的,其实是我妈妈。那纯粹是一派胡言。

lines.en: : Are you sure about that?
lines.zh: : 你确定?

lines.en: : Don’t do it, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 别说,Sensei……

lines.en: : Even you should draw the line at telling a little kid the truth about Santa Claus, Sensei. You’re better than this.
lines.zh: : 就算是你,也不该跨越底线、告诉一个小孩子圣诞老人的真相。你比这强。

lines.en: scene tsukasaday11
: The truth?
lines.zh: : 真相?

lines.en: : Did something happen to Santa Claus?
lines.zh: : 圣诞老人出什么事了吗?

lines.en: : If he was evicted due to the waste produced by his workshop, I would not mind forgoing some of my allowance to assist him. He does tremendous work for this country and is an asset to all of us.
lines.zh: : 如果他因为工坊产生的垃圾而被驱逐了,我不介意省下部分零花钱去帮助他。他为这个国家做着了不起的工作,是我们所有人的财富。

lines.en: : Just drop it, Sensei. Before it’s too late.
lines.zh: : 住手吧,Sensei。趁一切还来得及。

lines.en: : Fine. But I rest my case in showing that Tsukasa isn’t as smart as she thinks she is.
lines.zh: : 好吧。但我坚持我的结论:Tsukasa 没有她自己以为的那么聪明。

lines.en: : Yes, but that is only because you asked her a question that all of those prestigious educators dared not ever speak about.
lines.zh: : 是,但那只是因为你问了一个所有所谓「知名教育者」都不敢触碰的问题。

lines.en: : Why is everybody acting so weird? All it takes is a little personal research to figure out the truth.
lines.zh: : 为什么大家表现得这么怪?只要稍微自己查一查,就能弄清真相。

lines.en: : Can you people not afford computers?
lines.zh: : 你们这些人买不起电脑吗?

lines.en: scene tsukasaday12
: What do you think, Senpai? It would feel kind of wrong getting rid of her now. But, like I said before, I’m not really the best when it comes to kids.
lines.zh: : 你怎么看,学姐?现在赶走她,感觉有点不对。但就像我说的,对付小孩,我确实不在行。

lines.en: : And you think I am?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我就在行吗?

lines.en: : Well, you became a teacher, didn’t you? You’ve gotta be at least a little good with them.
lines.zh: : 嗯,你不是当老师了吗?你至少得稍微擅长跟小孩相处吧。

lines.en: : Didn’t...you also become a teacher?
lines.zh: : 你……不也当了老师?

lines.en: : Yeah, but I’ve still got time left.
lines.zh: : 对,但我还有的是时间。

lines.en: : I’m only 31.
: Damn, that old already? Need me to go grab a cane from the nurse’s office?
lines.zh: : 操,都这么老了吗?要我跑去保健室给你拿根拐杖吗?

lines.en: : Again! You people refuse to pay attention to the one person you should be paying all of your attention to today!
lines.zh: : 又来了!你们这些人拒绝把注意力放在今天唯一应该被全神贯注的人身上!

lines.en: : This insolence will not go unpunished! As soon as my father finds out about this, you two will never work another day in this town again! You-
lines.zh: : 这种无礼不会没有惩罚!等我爸爸发现这件事,你们俩在这个镇上将再也找不到工作!你们——

lines.en: : Tsukasa, please! They are doing their best! And all things considered, their best seems very good based on the standards of today’s public education system.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,求你了!她们已经尽力了!综合来看,以今日公立教育系统的标准,她们的尽力看起来相当不错。

lines.en: scene tsukasaday13
: Hah...This is exactly why the youth of the nation has become so lazy and unmotivated. No one gets the education they need anymore. Papa should really do something about that.
lines.zh: : 哈……这正是全国的青少年变得又懒又没动力的原因。没人再接受他们需要的教育。爸爸真该为此做点什么。

lines.en: : I agree but, unfortunately, progress didn’t have much place to go after the creation of bubble wrap.
lines.zh: : 我同意,但遗憾的是,自从气泡膜被发明之后,进步就没什么空间了。

lines.en: : Hey, Tsukasa. What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 嘿,Tsukasa。你来这里干什么?

lines.en: scene tsukasaday14
: Oh! The peasant girl from Mother’s onsen!
lines.zh: : 哦!妈妈温泉里的那个平民女孩!

lines.en: : And here I was thinking the strong scent of cheap perfume was just the way girls’ public schools smelled.
lines.zh: : 我还以为这股廉价香水味,就是女子公立学校的常态呢。

lines.en: scene tsukasaday15
: Is it...really that strong? Because I’m trying something new and that wasn’t exactly the type of reaction I was looking for.
lines.zh: : 有……那么浓吗?因为我在尝试一款新的,这并不是我想得到的反应。

lines.en: : What type of reaction were you looking for?
lines.zh: : 那你想得到什么反应?

lines.en: : A...positive one?
lines.zh: : 一个……正面的反应?

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, good luck.
lines.zh: : 那,祝你好运。

lines.en: scene tsukasaday16
: Th...That aside! How are things? How’s your mom?
lines.zh: : 那……先不说这个!最近怎么样?你妈妈呢?

lines.en: : Things are great! As you may have noticed from all of the banners in the hall, today is National Tsukasa Day!
lines.zh: : 一切都好!你可能已经从走廊的横幅注意到了,今天是全国月司日!

lines.en: : Unfortunately, Mother had other matters to attend to, so she is unable to spend it with me. But that’s okay because my big sister and her teacher are looking after me.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是,妈妈另有要务,无法陪我。但没关系,因为我姐姐和她的老师会照顾我。

lines.en: : Which isn’t to say I wouldn’t be able to function on my own when I am much better and smarter than both of them. But laws will be laws.
lines.zh: : 当然,这并不代表我一个人就玩不转——我比她们俩优秀、聪明得多。但法律就是法律。

lines.en: : You do know what “laws” are, correct?
lines.zh: : 你知道「法律」是什么,对吧?

lines.en: scene tsukasaday17
: Yes, Tsukasa. I do know what laws are.
lines.zh: : 知道,Tsukasa。我知道法律是什么。

lines.en: : Good! I never know with you people.
lines.zh: : 很好!你们这种人,我向来拿不准。

lines.en: : “You people” as in...commoners, right?
lines.zh: : 「我们这种人」是指……平民,对吧?

lines.en: : Good job! Public education has not entirely failed you yet.
lines.zh: : 答对了!公共教育还没有彻底辜负你。

lines.en: scene tsukasaday18
: That said, it would be wise to quit while you’re ahead and follow in the footsteps of your younger sister. She and I have big plans for this world.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此,见好就收、跟你妹妹学习才是明智之举。她和我对这个世界有宏大的计划。

lines.en: : Yeah, you two have been talking a lot lately, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 对,你们俩最近确实聊了很多,不是吗?

lines.en: : Talking? We’re not just talking. We’re drafting business plans that are going to flip Kumon-mi on its head. People like us do not have time to simply “talk.”
lines.zh: : 聊天?我们才不只是聊天。我们在起草即将颠覆 Kumon-mi 的商业计划。我们这种人的时间,可不能浪费在单纯的「聊天」上。

lines.en: : Well, would you maybe like to come over and discuss business in person sometime?
lines.zh: : 那,要不要哪天来我家,当面洽谈业务?

lines.en: scene tsukasaday19
: Can your budget home fit more than two people inside of it?
lines.zh: : 你的经济适用房,装得下两个以上的人吗?

lines.en: : Uhh...yes.
lines.zh: : 呃……可以。

lines.en: : Just...probably not more than five.
lines.zh: : 只是……多半装不下五个以上。

lines.en: : I can fit more people than that in my bathroom.
lines.zh: : 我的浴室里装的人比那多。

lines.en: : Why is that...ever a thing you’d want to do?
lines.zh: : 你为什么……会想干这种事?

lines.en: : It’s not. But I can and I felt compelled to inform you of that.
lines.zh: : 我不想。但我可以,而且我觉得有义务通知你这一点。

lines.en: scene tsukasaday20
: Either way, Chinami has been excited to see you again and I figure this would give you two a good chance to play together.
lines.zh: : 无论如何,Chinami 一直很期待再见到你,我想这正好给你们俩一个一起玩的机会。

lines.en: : I will consider it and consult with the rest of my business associates!
lines.zh: : 我会考虑,并咨询我其余的商业伙伴!

lines.en: : If I do agree to play though, will you consider teaching Chinami and I the special game you played with your teacher at the onsen? Mother says it’s for adults, but I have proven today that I-
lines.zh: : 不过我要是答应玩了,你会考虑教我和 Chinami 你和你的老师在温泉里玩的那个特殊游戏吗?妈妈说那是大人的游戏,但我今天已经证明,我——

lines.en: scene tsukasaday21
: MMMFMFMFMFMFMFFFFFMFHHFHFFF!!!!!
lines.zh: : 唔唔唔唔唔唔!!!!!

lines.en: : Special game?...
lines.zh: : 特殊游戏?……

lines.en: : Onsen?...
: Hahaha! Kids, right?! Always making up stories!
lines.zh: : 哈哈!小孩子嘛!总是编故事!

lines.en: : Oh, look. A stack of papers way at the...other end of the school that I need you to file.
lines.zh: : 哦,看。学校「另一头」有一叠文件,需要你去归档。

lines.en: scene tsukasaday22
: You trying to teach Chika how to time travel, Senpai?
lines.zh: : 你在教 Chika 时间旅行吗,学姐?

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : And at an onsen? What does that mean for all of the other girls who had to stare at your drab-ass wallpaper while you were doin’ ‘em dirty?
lines.zh: : 还是在温泉里?那对其他女孩算什么——她们只能瞪着你那张无聊透顶的墙纸,而你在暗地里干她们?

lines.en: : Is that really what you’re most concerned about?
lines.zh: : 这真是你最关心的事?

lines.en: : I’m an advocate for equality, Senpai. We all deserve onsens.
lines.zh: : 我是平等的拥护者,学姐。我们每个人都配拥有温泉。

lines.en: : Well, I’ll add you to the top of my...prospective onsen visit list now.
lines.zh: : 好吧,我把你加进我的……潜在温泉访客名单的最顶端了。

lines.en: : Think saying that might be giving me a little too much attention on National Tsukasa Day, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 在全国月司日说这种话,是不是有点抢我的风头?

lines.en: scene tsukasaday23
: MMMFMFMFMFMFFHFHFHFFMMFMFM!!!!!!!! MMMMM!!!!!!!
: Tsukasa, what does Mother say about making a racket like that? Quiet down or you’ll attract negative press.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,妈妈说过弄出这种噪音会怎样?安静,不然会招来负面新闻。

lines.en: : MMMMMMMMMM!!!!!!!!!!!!
: Tsukasa...I’m gonna let you go now. But I kinda need you to not say anything about the onsen, okay? Nobody is supposed to know about that.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……我现在放你下来。但我有点需要你别提温泉的事,好吗?那件事不该让任何人知道。

lines.en: : MMMM! MMMMM! MMMM!!!
lines.zh: : 唔唔!唔唔唔!唔唔!!!

lines.en: scene tsukasaday24
: Are you out of your mind?! Do you have any idea who I am?! Do you think it’s okay to just assault a princess?! I will have your head!
lines.zh: : 你疯了吗?!你知道我是谁吗?!你以为袭击一位公主是可以的吗?!我要你的命!

lines.en: : But if you kill me, Chinami won’t want to do business with you anymore, so...your success kinda hinges on me in a way, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 可你要是杀了我,Chinami 就不想和你做生意了,所以……你的成功某种程度上系于我一身,不是吗?

lines.en: scene tsukasaday25
: While it is true that an ally like her would certainly take us to the next level, I’m not quite sure if it is worth my own personal safety.
lines.zh: : 虽然拥有她这样的盟友确实能让我们的层级跃升,但我不太确定,这值不值得拿我的人身安全去冒险。

lines.en: : What if I...promise not to grab your face anymore?
lines.zh: : 那,如果我……保证再也不抓你的脸呢?

lines.en: : That would be a start...but I am going to need something a little more than that.
lines.zh: : 那会是一个开始……但我还需要一点别的东西。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: You can eat...cereal when you come over to my place?
lines.zh: : 你来我家的时候……可以吃麦片?

lines.en: scene tsukasaday26
: C...Cereal? But Mother says cereal is a leading cause of diabetes and that there are much tastier and healthier alternatives.
lines.zh: : 麦……麦片?可是妈妈说,麦片是糖尿病的头号诱因,还有好吃得多、健康得多的替代品。

lines.en: : And while I’m sure she’s right...you do want a taste of commoner life, don’t you? What better taste than eating the same thing Chinami eats every morning inside of Chinami’s house?
lines.zh: : 虽然我确信她是对的……但你不是想体验一下平民生活吗?还有什么比「在 Chinami 家里,吃 Chinami 每天早上吃的同一样东西」更好的体验呢?

lines.en: : Think of it as a...research...project.
lines.zh: : 把它当成一个……研究……项目。

lines.en: scene tsukasaday27
: You drive a hard bargain, peasant. That does sound like something that tickles my interest. However, I have one final adjustment I’d like to add to your offer.
lines.zh: : 你的要价真狠,平民。这确实听起来像能挠到我兴趣的东西。不过,你的提议我还有最后一处调整。

lines.en: : And that...adjustment is?
lines.zh: : 那……调整是?

lines.en: scene tsukasaday28
: Can my sister come too?
lines.zh: : 我姐姐可以一起来吗?

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be fair if I got to experience something like that firsthand and she did not. I am simply doing this so that the two of us may remain on equal footing.
lines.zh: : 我一个人体验了那种东西、她却没有,这不公平。我这么做,只是为了让姐妹俩保持平等的地位。

lines.en: : It is the least I can do in exchange for intruding on her personal life by being here.
lines.zh: : 何况,我已经擅自闯入了她的私生活,这是我至少能做的补偿。

lines.en: : Tsukasa...I don’t really need to-
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……我真的不需要——

lines.en: : Sure, yeah. That’s actually...
lines.zh: : 行,好。这其实……

lines.en: scene tsukasaday29
: You know what? Why don’t we invite Sensei too?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗?要不我们也邀请 Sensei?

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : That seems unnecessary. Jeeves has no place in the same room as two serious and powerful businesswomen. And also Onee-chan.
lines.zh: : 那似乎没有必要。Jeeves 没资格和两位严肃而强大的女实业家同处一室。还有 Onee-chan 也不行。

lines.en: : Why is Sensei...suddenly a part of this as well, Chika?
lines.zh: : 为什么 Sensei……也突然成为其中一员了,Chika?

lines.en: : Because I was looking for a good time to go do something lately and kind of need a babysitter since I have no idea how long it will take.
lines.zh: : 因为我最近一直想找时机去办一件事,而我很需要一位保姆,因为我不知道要花多久。

lines.en: : Which isn’t to say I don’t trust you, Touka. I just...don’t really know if you'll be able to grasp any of the, uhh...commoner technology at my place.
lines.zh: : 不是说我不信任你,Touka。我只是……不太确定你能不能弄明白我家那些……呃……平民科技。

lines.en: : I mean...I guess I can come? I doubt I’ll be much help, though.
lines.zh: : 呃……我可以去?虽然我怀疑我帮不上什么忙。

lines.en: : Jeeves can wait in the lobby while the rest of us talk. That seems fair to me.
lines.zh: : Jeeves 可以在大厅等着,我们其他人谈。我觉得这样挺公平。

lines.en: : I don’t believe Chika’s home is the type to have a lobby, Tsukasa. Sensei can wait in her rose garden instead.
lines.zh: : 我不认为 Chika 家是有「大厅」的类型,Tsukasa。Sensei 可以改去她的玫瑰园等。

lines.en: : Sensei? You cool with that?
lines.zh: : Sensei?你没问题吧?

lines.en: : Depends. Do you have a rose garden now?
lines.zh: : 看情况。你现在有玫瑰园了?

lines.en: : Who doesn’t?
lines.zh: : 谁没有?

lines.en: : Told you so, Tsukasa. You should listen to me more often.
lines.zh: : 说了吧,Tsukasa。你该多听我的。

lines.en: : Stop making so many silly decisions and I will.
lines.zh: : 少做一些愚蠢的决定,我就听。

lines.en: scene black
Somehow, I wound up getting roped into agreeing to be a babysitter for both Chinami and Tsukasa soon.
lines.zh: : 不知怎么,我就这样被套进了一个承诺:近期要给 Chinami 和 Tsukasa 两个当保姆。

lines.en: That doesn’t sound exhausting at all.
lines.zh: : 这听起来一点都不累人呢。

lines.en: Thankfully, I’ll at least have Touka there with me. And while that probably won’t really help either, it will definitely help me feel a little more normal as there’s at least someone who isn’t...
lines.zh: : 所幸,至少 Touka 会陪着我。虽然那多半帮不上什么忙,但它 definite 会让我感觉正常一点——至少在场有一个不是……

lines.en: Well, someone who isn’t a full blown child there.
lines.zh: : 嗯,不是「一个彻底的小孩」的人。

lines.en: Plus, an environment like that sounds like the perfect place to fuck with her. And that is quickly becoming one of my favorite past times.
lines.zh: : 况且,那样的环境听起来是捉弄她的完美场所。而那正迅速成为我最喜欢的消遣之一。

lines.en: Anyway, the day comes to an end- and I find myself retreating back to my office.
lines.zh: : 总之,这一天结束了——我发现自己退回了办公室。
